regime_window_dependence.primary_p_value_semantics: 30-minute block sign-flip evidence conditional on the observed regime windows.
regime_window_dependence.bootstrap_semantics: The 5000-draw object labelled equal-event bootstrap resamples regime-window EventEvidence rows, not independent event families.
regime_window_dependence.cross_election_warning: With only three event families, these intervals are not calibrated cross-election 95% confidence intervals.
regime_window_dependence.lowrank_warning: LOWRANK usable evidence is from one regime/event family; its equal-event interval is a degenerate one-window resample and is non-inferential for cross-event uncertainty.
regime_window_dependence.promotion_gate_warning: The frozen promotion predicate requires more than one usable regime/event row, which is weaker than independent event-family replication. No false promotion occurred.

holdout_geometry.interpretation: EXP003 HOLDOUT evidence is predominantly post-election/count/settlement-regime evidence and is not election-night validation.

target_and_metric.economic_warning: Logit-MSE is a predictive-coordinate metric, not P&L. Equal probability moves near 0/1 map to larger logit moves than near 0.5, so tail markets can receive disproportionate squared-loss weight. sqrt(delta MSE) must not be converted directly into cents.

quote_freshness.implementation: QuoteSeries is built only from book_changes and requires the most recent change to be within the freshness bound at t and t+h.
quote_freshness.warning: A quiet unchanged book can become ineligible because no recent book_changes row exists. This is not equivalent to an independent feed-health/heartbeat staleness measure.

rv_and_loo_scope.tested: Naive equal-weight logit-level-gap residual: -(logit(target level) - mean(logit(reference levels))).
rv_and_loo_scope.not_tested: Calibrated pair-specific structural/fair-value mappings with TRAIN-estimated offsets/slopes or exhaustive-partition reconstruction.
rv_and_loo_scope.loo_price: Same-event sibling level-gap diagnostic, not exact exhaustive-partition reconstruction.

ablations_and_controls.structural_ablation: The frozen structural ablation 'passed' flag checks that both LOO lanes have observations; it is not a substantive ablation-effect test.
ablations_and_controls.other_families: Non-structural ablations are recorded passed=True by construction.
ablations_and_controls.rv_zero_residual: The zero-residual negative control algebraically collapses challenger information to the baseline.
ablations_and_controls.interpretation: No false promotion occurred, but future promotion logic must require substantive ablation evidence.

microstructure.feature_dependency: microprice_displacement_over_spread is algebraically equal to top_book_imbalance / 2 under the implemented top-level formula.
microstructure.interpretation: The two advertised additions provide one degree of information, not two independent microstructure signals.

rejection_rule.frozen_rule: REJECTED requires the equal-event upper interval <= 0 at all five horizons.
rejection_rule.future_requirement: Preregister a smallest economically meaningful effect / futility threshold rather than relying only on exact-zero rejection.

leadlag_sampling.interpretation: This clock-grid design samples a narrow slice of short impulses. EXP003 is a weak same-venue historical screen, not a decisive event-time lead/lag test.

lowrank_amendment.note: The pre-result amendment implements minimum_reference_markets=3 as exactly the first three references in the frozen coverage ordering.
lowrank_amendment.interpretation: This is a documented label-free design choice, not the unique semantic consequence of 'at least 3'. LOWRANK remains severely underpowered.

future_confirmation_requirements: Aggregate and hold out at event-family level where feasible.
Use event-time/election-time holdouts for election-night claims.
Add block-size robustness and dependence-aware model-comparison evidence (for example SPA, Romano-Wolf, or model-confidence-set style procedures).
Report probability-space effect sizes alongside logit-space metrics and executable markouts by signal strength.
Separate quote state carry-forward from feed-health/heartbeat evidence.
Require substantive ablations before BUILD-008 promotion.
